name: In Favor of Darkness
summary: Dark Cleric Duesten sends you from Deathknell to Brill for In Favor of Darkness. There, you continue training with Dark Cleric Beryl and study the Holy Light and Shadow.

sections.title: A Path Carved in Rot
sections.body: Dark Cleric Duesten teaches that corruption forged the Forsaken, then cast them aside like carrion. To survive, they must understand both Light and Shadow without sentiment. You leave Deathknell's graveyard and enter the wider world beyond its walls.

sections.title: Instruction in Brill
sections.body: You follow the road northeast from Deathknell, cross a wooden covered bridge, and reach ruined Brill. Dark Cleric Beryl waits in the upper quarters of the local inn to test your resolve. He prizes ambition and cold practicality over blind devotion. A Forsaken priest must wield divine power as a weapon and a tool, never as a moral crutch.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Dark Cleric Duesten sends you from Deathknell to Brill to continue your training as a Forsaken priest. Dark Cleric Beryl gives you your next priestly challenge.

faq.q: Why do Forsaken priests use the Light if they embrace darkness?
aliases: why do undead priests use light
faq.answer: Forsaken clerics study both Light and Shadow because they believe the world is governed by their balance. The Holy Light brings excruciating pain to undead flesh, while Forsaken origins lie in rot and darkness. They study both forces out of necessity and practical need.

faq.q: Where do I find Dark Cleric Beryl?
faq.answer: Dark Cleric Beryl is in Brill, northeast of Deathknell. He lives on the second floor of the Gallows' End Tavern, on the settlement's eastern side.

faq.q: What does this quest lead into?
aliases: next quest after in favor of darkness
faq.answer: Speaking with Dark Cleric Beryl completes your training here and opens Garments of Darkness. He then tests your ability to mend and sustain allies with your new disciplines.
Dark Cleric Duesten is the priest trainer in Deathknell. He helps newly awakened Forsaken priests understand their painful existence and use their spiritual powers.

faq.q: Why does Beryl mention ambition over faith?
faq.answer: Forsaken priests consider traditional pious faith insufficient after the powers they worshipped in life abandoned them. Dark Cleric Beryl expects his disciples to rely on ambition, urgency, and practical strength to survive.

angles.text: As a priest, you learn the Forsaken way: wield Holy Light and Shadow with cold discretion, not religious reverence.
As an Undead, you travel from Deathknell to Brill on a first journey into the wider Forsaken realm. The journey shows initiates how their people rebuild amid Lordaeron's ruins.
